statement: The restricting factor for scaling a relational database is that its relations and consistency guarantees need all the data to be in one place; non-relational databases typically do not give you these features, so they are not bound by it.
detail: Said between the backstory (relational databases chose consistency over ingestion rate) and the fix (drop foreign keys to partition). It is the causal link between the two, which no part item states.
speaker: teacher
verbatim: if this is the restricting factor where you need all the data to be in one place and whatnot
